youtube.title: What if you sat next to D.B. Cooper on his flight?
youtube.description:
Nov 24, 1971: a quiet man in a dark suit takes the seat next to you on Flight 305 – then hands the flight attendant a note. ✈️💼 55 years later, nobody knows who he was.
He opens the briefcase. What do you do? A) Warn the crew B) Stay silent C) Talk to him – Comment A, B or C 👇
Sources: FBI (D.B. Cooper hijacking case), Cowboy State Daily (FBI files and parachute tests, 2026)
